content: In the Tuḥfa-yi ʿAlāʾī (the sentence begins on p.147) Ibn Turka states that his family has always belonged to the Shafiʿi rite; the treatise refers the reader to the Iṣbāḥ al-Anwār for more detail, and its introduction complains of the harsh treatment he experienced in Herat.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, Tuḥfa-yi ʿAlāʾī, introduction and rite statement
